verses.sanskrit:
शौनक उवाच।
              उक्तोऽयं हरिवंशस्ते पर्वाणि निखिलानि च। यथा पुरोक्तानि तथा व्यासशिष्येण धीमता॥१॥
verses.english: Hail कृष्ण-द्वैपायन who is said to be the sixth one starting from the great-great-grandfather, i.e., the efficient cause, namely nArAyaNa; hail him who has unlessened opulence of scriptural knowledge; who took birth with an astral shade of nArAyaNa himself; who is the only son of sage parAshara, and who is a treasure trove of Veda-s... hail such a great sage kR^iShNa-dwaipAyana...

verses.sanskrit: तत्कथ्यमानममितमितिहाससमन्वितम्। प्रीणात्यस्मानमृतवत्सर्वपापविनाशनम्॥२॥
verses.english: Then, oh, king, swayambhu manu, or Apava prajApati stayed encompassing the firmament by virtue of his yogic power, and his wife designate shata-rUpa manifested herself diversely by the dint of svayambhu's yogic power.

verses.sanskrit: सुखश्राव्यतया धीर मनोह्लादयतीव नः। जनमेजयस्तु नृपतिः श्रुत्वा चाख्यानमुत्तमम्। सौते किमकरोत्पश्चात्सर्पसत्रादनन्तरम्॥३॥
verses.english: And from those females and respective males, gods, birds, serpents, cows, daitya-dAnava-gadharvA-s, apsara-s have emerged, besides a host of other living beings of diverse species.

verses.sanskrit:
सौतिरुवाच।
              जनमेजयस्तु स नृपः श्रुत्वा चाख्यानमुत्तमम्। यदारभत्तदाख्यास्ये सर्पसत्रादनन्तरम्॥४॥
verses.english: Thus that Apava prajApati alone is called swAyambhuva manu oh, sire, janamejaya, a time-cycle consisting seventy one yuga-s, eras, is named after him, known as a manvantaram

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्सत्रे समाप्तेऽथ राजा पारीक्षितस्तदा। यष्टुं स वाजिमेधेन सम्भारानुपचक्रमे॥५॥
verses.english: In ten thousand years trees mushroomed overhead, and air ceased to circulate, whereupon living-beings are rendered inanimate.

verses.sanskrit: ऋत्विक्पुरोहिताचार्यानाहूयेदमुवाच ह। यक्ष्येऽहं वाजिमेधेन हयमुत्सृज्यतामिति॥६॥
verses.english: There is another damsel named kAmya who is the daughter of kardama prajApati. This girl on taking प्रियव्रत as her husband gave rise to four sons called साम्राट्, कुक्शि, विराट्, and prabhu - thus वीर has six sons in total.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽस्य विज्ञाय चिकीर्षितं तदा कृष्णो महात्मा सहसाऽऽजगाम। पारीक्षितं द्रष्टुमदीनसत्त्वं द्वैपायनः सर्वपरावरज्ञः॥७॥
verses.english: Then prajApati अत्रि adopted उत्तानपद as his son, and uttAnapAda begot four sons from a damsel called सूनृत, or also called as सुनीत.

verses.sanskrit: पारीक्षितस्तु नृपतिर्दृष्ट्वा तमृषिमागतम्। अर्घ्यपाद्यासनं दत्त्वा पूजयामास शास्त्रतः॥८॥
verses.english: This curvaceous damsel well-known as सूनृत is the daughter of धर्म. That is to say, this girl actually emerged from the horse-ritual of dharma, hence she is the daughter of dharma, and she is the auspicious mother of ध्रुव, too. uttAnapAda-prajApati begot four sons through this सूनृत, who are ध्रुव, कीर्ति-मन्त, a calm-and-collected boy शिव, and अयस्पति.

verses.sanskrit: तौ चोपविष्टावभितः सदस्यास्तस्य शौनक। कथा बहुविधाश्चित्राश्चक्राते वेदसंहिताः॥९॥
verses.english: Then prajApati अत्रि adopted उत्तानपद as his son, and uttAnapAda begot four sons from a damsel called सूनृत, or also called as सुनीत.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कथान्ते नृपतिर्नोदयामास तं मुनिम्। पितामहं पाण्डवानामात्मनः प्रपितामहम्॥१०॥
verses.english: And lady sAvarNI gave rise to ten sons of prAchIna-barhi, where those ten sons are called by a single collective name - प्राचेतस-s, who are experts in missile-archery.

verses.sanskrit: महाभारतमाख्यानं बह्वर्थं श्रुतिविस्तरम्। निमेषमात्रमपि मे सुखश्राव्यतया गतम्॥११॥
verses.english: And oh, bharata, dhruva undertook ascesis for three thousand divine years, praying for the grace of most glorious almighty. Pleased with his ascesis, brahma, the foremost prajApati, bestowed upon him a nonpareil and changeless station in the vault of heaven loftier than that of seven-sages constellation, Ursa Major. This is called ध्रुव मण्डल - sphere of North Star.

verses.sanskrit: विभूतिविस्तारकरं सर्वेषां वै यशस्करम्। त्वया सुविहितं ब्रह्मञ्शङ्खे क्षीरमिवाहितम्॥१२॥
verses.english: Observing the remarkable achievement and efficacy of ascesis of dhruva, the mentor of gods and demons, namely शुक्र-आचार्य, sung a verse in his honour 'what a rigour in ascesis what knowledge in scriptures what a resolvedness this dhruva has whereby the seven-sages are standing there keeping him in their van'
verses.bhavadeepa: मे मम निमेषमात्रमोतो संवत्सरोऽपि निमेषमात्रमोव गतः। अपिरिवार्थे॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: अमृतेन तु तृप्तिः स्याद्यथा स्वर्गसुखेन च। तथा तृप्तिं न गच्छामि श्रुत्वेमां भारतीं कथाम्॥१३॥
verses.english: ध्रुव begot two sons, named श्लिष्टि and भव्य, from his wife, namely lady शम्भु. And shliShTi begot five blemishless sons, namely रिपु, रिपुन्-जय, पुण्य, वृक्ल, वृक-तेज from his wife named सु-cछाया।

verses.sanskrit: अनुमान्य तु सर्वज्ञं पृच्छामि भगवन्नहम्। हेतुः कुरूणां नाशस्य राजसूयो मतो मम॥१४॥
verses.english: And from रिपु his wife named बृहति gave rise to most effulgent son named चाक्शुष.

verses.sanskrit: दुःसहानां यथा ध्वंसो राजन्यानामुपप्लवे। राजसूयं तथा मन्ये युद्धार्थमुपकल्पितम्॥१५॥
verses.english: There emerged a son, called मनु, to this chAkshuSha through his wife named पुष्करिणि, the daughter of वीरण.

verses.sanskrit: राजसूयस्तु सोमेन श्रूयते पूर्वमाहृतः। तस्यान्ते सुमहद्युद्धमभवत्तारकामयम्॥१६॥
verses.english: Then, pracetasA-s on listening to the words of soma, the moon, controlled their anger towards trees, and took mAriSha as their collective wife, ritually.

verses.sanskrit: आहृतो वरुणेनाथ तस्यान्ते सुमहाक्रतोः। देवासुरं महायुद्धं सर्वभूतक्षयावहम्॥१७॥
verses.english: "This girl, a jewel among beauties, is the daughter of vegetation, and as I am aware of the futurity I have contained and nurtured her in my womb

verses.sanskrit: हरिश्चन्द्रश्व राजर्षिः क्रतुमेनमुपाहरत्। तत्राप्याडीबकं नाम युद्धं क्षत्रियनाशनम्॥१८॥
verses.english: From Uru, the daughter of agni, namely lady आग्नेयि, gave rise to six highly brilliant sons, and they are - अन्ग, सुमन, ख्याति, क्रतु, अन्गीइरस, and गय.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽनन्तरमार्गेण पाण्डवेनातिदुस्तरः। महाभारत आरम्भः सम्भृतोऽग्निरिव क्रतुः॥१९॥
verses.english: ऊरु, पुरु, शत-द्युम्न, तपस्वि, सत्यवान्, कवि, अग्नि-ष्टुत, अति-रात्र, and सुद्युम्न - these are nine, and the tenth one is अभिमन्यु; these are renowned as the sons of lady naDwala.
verses.bhavadeepa: आडी जलचरः पक्षिविशेषः तद्रूपेण वसिष्ठः बकरूपेण विश्वामित्रश्च। ऋषित्वाल्लज्जया च प्राकट्येन युद्धं कर्तुमशक्तौ तयोर्युद्धमाडीबकं नाम तन्निमित्तम् उभयपक्षपातिनां क्षत्रियाणां नाशो वृत्त इत्यर्थः॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit: तदस्य मूलं युद्धस्य लोकक्षयकरस्य तु। राजसूयो महायज्ञः किमर्थं न निवारितः॥२०॥
verses.english: But the sages put vena's arms to friction with a view to obtain his progeny, and while sages are thus chafing, there emerged emperor पृथु, from the right palm of vena.

verses.sanskrit: राजसूयो ह्यसंहार्यो यज्ञाङ्गैश्च दुरत्ययैः। मिथ्या प्रणीते यज्ञाङ्गे प्रजानां सङ्क्षयो ध्रुवः॥२१॥
verses.english: On seeing pR^ithu, the sages have said in certainty that, "this highly resplendent boy, namely pR^ithu, will acquire fame and renown, and he will make people happy"

verses.sanskrit: भवानपि च सर्वेषां पूर्वेषां नः पितामहः। अतीतानागतज्ञश्च नाथश्चादिकरश्च नः॥२२॥
verses.english: As if to burn down adversaries, this earliest kshatriya pR^ithu wielded bow, armour and sword, whereby he safeguarded this earth.

verses.sanskrit: ते कथं भवता नेत्रा बुद्धिमन्तश्च्युता नयात्। अनाथा ह्यपराध्यन्ते कुनेतारश्च मानवाः॥२३॥
verses.english: And pR^ithu is the foremost among the kings that are re-anointed through rAjasUya ritual, and there emerged सूत-s, the balladeers, who sing the glory of kings; and मागधा-s, the minstrels, who sing the praise of the dynasties of kings, from the ritual fire of pR^ithu's rAjasUya ritual.

verses.sanskrit:
व्यास उवाच।
              कालेन विपरीतास्ते तव पूर्वापितामहः। न मां भविष्यं पृच्छन्ति न चापृष्टो ब्रवीम्यहम्॥२४॥
verses.english: And pR^ithu is the foremost among the kings that are re-anointed through rAjasUya ritual, and there emerged सूत-s, the balladeers, who sing the glory of kings; and मागधा-s, the minstrels, who sing the praise of the dynasties of kings, from the ritual fire of pR^ithu's rAjasUya ritual.

verses.sanskrit: सामर्थ्यं च न पश्यामि भविष्यस्य निवर्तने। परिहर्तुं न शक्या हि कालेन विहिता गतिः॥२५॥
verses.english: And that lord daksha gave ten of those females to धर्म; thirteen to कश्यप prajApati; and the remaining ones, twenty-seven of them, to the king सोम, namely moon, since those twenty-seven females bear the names of constellations like अश्विनि, भरणि, कृत्तिक etc.  their progeny arundhati earth with all her paraphenalia earth with all her paraphenalia vasu eight vasu-s - bhIShma is one of them in earlier birth eight vasu-s - bhIShma is one of them in earlier birth yAmi / jAmi presiding deity of thick forest presiding deity of thick forest langha / lamba ghoSha / vidyota ghoSha / vidyota bhAnu bhAnu-s bhAnu-s marudvati marutvanta; jayanta marutvanta; jayanta samkalpa samkalpa-s - the volition to do anything positive samkalpa-s - the volition to do anything positive muhUrta mauhIrtika-s mauhIrtika-s sAdhya sAdhyA-s sAdhyA-s vishva vishve-devA-s vishve-devA-s   their progeny   1. diti daityA-s daityA-s 2. aditi AdityA-s AdityA-s 3. danu dAnavA-s dAnavA-s 4. anAyu, or anuaga siddhA-s siddhA-s 5. prAtha gandharvA-s gandharvA-s 6. muni apsarasa-s, and gandharvA-s called mAneyA-s apsarasa-s, and gandharvA-s called mAneyA-s 7. surasa yakshA-s, rAkshasA-s yakshA-s, rAkshasA-s 8. ila vR^iksha, latA, tR^iNa - trees, plants, creepers - all flora vR^iksha, latA, tR^iNa - trees, plants, creepers - all flora 9. krodhavasha lions, tigers - all carnivorous fauna lions, tigers - all carnivorous fauna 10. tAmra avians like eagles, birds, and horses, asses, camels etc avians like eagles, birds, and horses, asses, camels etc 11. kapila, or, surabhi go gaNa - cows and cattle go gaNa - cows and cattle 12. vinata anUru, garuDa anUru, garuDa 13. kadruva reptiles reptiles

verses.sanskrit: त्वया त्विदमहं पृष्टो वक्ष्याम्यागन्तु भावि यत्। अतश्च बलवान्कालः श्रुत्वाऽपि न करिष्यसि॥२६॥
verses.english: When the assemblages of manes, दानवा-स्, गन्धर्वा-स्, अप्सर-स्, रेप्तिलेस्, यक्श-स् [पुण्य जन], together with trees and mountains have taken up milking vessels and milked cowlike earth, earth has given milk / produce according as their requirement, and all of them felt that their livelihood is unhindered. That is to say, pR^ithu met with all the requirements of earthlings by propitiating mother earth.

verses.sanskrit: न संरम्भान्न चारम्भान्न वै स्थास्यसि पौरुषे। लेखा हि काललिखिताः सर्वथा दुरतिक्रमाः॥२७॥
verses.english: When the assemblages of manes, दानवा-स्, गन्धर्वा-स्, अप्सर-स्, रेप्तिलेस्, यक्श-स् [पुण्य जन], together with trees and mountains have taken up milking vessels and milked cowlike earth, earth has given milk / produce according as their requirement, and all of them felt that their livelihood is unhindered. That is to say, pR^ithu met with all the requirements of earthlings by propitiating mother earth.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधः क्रतुः श्रेष्ठः क्षत्रियाणां परिश्रुतः। तेन भावेन ते यज्ञं वासवो धर्षयिष्यति॥२८॥
verses.english: pR^ithu had two virtuous sons, namely अन्तर्-धी and पालित, and अन्तर्धी begot a son named हविधान from his wife named lady शिखण्डिनि.

verses.sanskrit: यदि तच्छक्यते राजन्परिहर्तुं कथञ्चन। दैवं पुरुषकारेण मा यजेथाश्च तं क्रतुम्॥२९॥
verses.english: "All of you, oh, prAchetasa-kings, may please leave off your fury oh, sons of prAchIna-brahi you have almost bared the earth of her trees now let the blazing fire and eroding air surcease" So started soma to advice prAchetasa-s...

verses.sanskrit: न चापराधः शक्रस्य नोपाध्यायगणस्य ते। तव वा यजमानस्य कालोऽत्र दुरतिक्रमः॥३०॥
verses.english: Oh, janamejaya, when the sacred grass is spread on earth with their tips pointing to east in his vedic-rituals, that grass looked like sprawling on whole of the earth, indicating the wideness of his sway on earth, and hence he is known as godly prAchIna-brahi.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य संस्थाकृतमिदं कालस्य परमेष्ठिनः। यथादृष्टं प्रजासर्गं गमिष्यति युगक्षये॥३१॥
verses.english: And after a long lasting ascesis that lord and king prAchIna-barhi married the daughter of ocean, namely lady सावर्णि.

verses.sanskrit: तथा यज्ञफलानां च विक्रेतारो द्विजातयः। तत्प्रणेयं निबोधस्व त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्॥३२॥
verses.english: That fraternity of ten have a common school in duty and action, and at certain time they undertook a rigorous ascesis for ten thousand years submersed in oceanic water.
verses.bhavadeepa: तस्य क्रतोः संस्था समाप्तिस्तदर्थं कृतमिदं भावि कालुष्यम्। कालस्य इच्छयेति शेषः॥३१॥

verses.sanskrit:
जनमेजय उवाच।
              निवृत्तावश्वमेधस्य किं निमित्तं भविष्यति। श्रुत्वा परिहरिष्यामि भगवन्यदि मन्यसे॥३३॥
verses.english: That fraternity of ten have a common school in duty and action, and at certain time they undertook a rigorous ascesis for ten thousand years submersed in oceanic water.

verses.sanskrit:
व्यास उवाच।
              निमित्तं भविता तत्र ब्रह्मकोपकृतं प्रभो। यतेथाः परिहर्तुं त्वमित्येतद्भद्रमस्तु ते॥३४॥
verses.english: And when those ten brothers are deep in their ascesis, then the earth has become unprotected because she lacked a protector, whereby the overspread of trees on earth has become so thick that the earth is unventilated, whereof people started to perish.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया वृत्तं क्रतुं चैव वाजिमेधं परन्तप। क्षत्रियानाहरिष्यन्ति यावद्भूमिर्धरिष्यति॥३५॥
verses.english: In ten thousand years trees mushroomed overhead, and air ceased to circulate, whereupon living-beings are rendered inanimate.

verses.sanskrit:
जनमेजय उवाच।
              निवृत्तावश्वमेधस्य ब्रह्मशापाग्नितेजसा। अहं निमित्तमिति मे भयं तीव्रं तु जायते॥३६॥
verses.english: On noticing this situation with an ascetic intuition, all the ten prAchetasa-s furiously vented air as well as fire from their faces.

verses.sanskrit: कथं ह्यकीर्त्या युज्येत सुकृती मद्विधो जनः। लोकानुत्सहते गन्तुं खं सपाश इव द्विजः॥३७॥
verses.english: On noticing this situation with an ascetic intuition, all the ten prAchetasa-s furiously vented air as well as fire from their faces.

verses.sanskrit: यथा ह्यनागतमिदं दृष्टमत्र प्रणाशनम्। यद्यस्ति पुनरावृत्तिर्यज्ञस्याश्वासयस्व माम्॥३८॥
verses.english: Noticing the near-extinction of trees in a non-stop manner, the king of vegetation, namely सोम, or chandra - the presiding deity of the moon, also called rAja, the king, approached the ten prAchetasa brothers and spoke to them in this way.

verses.sanskrit:
व्यास उवाच।
              उपात्तयज्ञो देवेषु ब्राह्मणेषूपपत्स्यते। तेजसा व्याहृतं तेजस्तेजस्येवावतिष्ठते॥३९॥
verses.english: Noticing the near-extinction of trees in a non-stop manner, the king of vegetation, namely सोम, or chandra - the presiding deity of the moon, also called rAja, the king, approached the ten prAchetasa brothers and spoke to them in this way.

verses.sanskrit: औद्भिज्जो भविता कश्चित्सेनानीः काश्यपो द्विजः। अश्वमेधं कलियुगे पुनः प्रत्याहरिष्यति॥४०॥
verses.english: "This girl, a jewel among beauties, is the daughter of vegetation, and as I am aware of the futurity I have contained and nurtured her in my womb

verses.sanskrit: तद्युगे तत्कुलीनश्च राजसूयमपि क्रतुम्। आहरिष्यति राजेन्द्र श्वेतग्रहमिवान्तकः॥४१॥
verses.english: "She who is formulated by vegetation is मारिष by her name, and oh, high-minded prachetA-s, she being the augmenter of lunar dynasty, you accept her as your wife
verses.bhavadeepa: उद्भिद्य जायत इत्यौद्भिज्जः भूविलस्यो यिगी खन्यमानायां भुवि प्रकटीभविष्यतीत्यर्थः॥४०॥

verses.sanskrit: यथा बलं मनुष्याणां कर्तॄणां दास्यते फलम्। युगान्तद्वारमृषिभिः संवृतं विचरिष्यति॥४२॥
verses.english: "She who is formulated by vegetation is मारिष by her name, and oh, high-minded prachetA-s, she being the augmenter of lunar dynasty, you accept her as your wife

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति हास्यन्ति नृणां प्राणाः पुराकृतीः। न निवर्तिष्यते लोके वृत्तान्तावर्तनेष्विह॥४३॥
verses.english: Then, pracetasA-s on listening to the words of soma, the moon, controlled their anger towards trees, and took mAriSha as their collective wife, ritually.
verses.bhavadeepa: बलं श्रद्धादिरूपं फलं दास्यते क्रतुरिति शेषः। संवृतं गोपितं विचरतिष्यति जनः॥४२॥

verses.sanskrit: तदा सुक्ष्मो महोदर्को दुस्तरो दानमूलवान्। चातुराश्रम्यशिथिलो धर्मः प्रविचलिष्यति॥४४॥
verses.english: Then, oh, king janamejaya, all the ten prAcetasA-s have astrally impregnated mAriSha, and through her they begot a highly resplendent prajApati named दक्श, who emerged with a shade of anima of soma, the moon
verses.bhavadeepa: तदाप्रभृति युगान्तमारभ्य प्राणा इन्द्रियाणि पुराकृतीः शिष्टाचारान्वर्तनेषु आचारेषु वृत्तान्तः पूर्ववृत्तं न नितरां वर्तिष्यते॥४३॥

verses.sanskrit: तदा ह्यल्पेन तपसा सिद्धि प्राप्स्यन्ति मानवाः। धन्या धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति युगान्ते जनमेजय॥४५॥
verses.english: Later, daksha prajApati started to bring forth those living beings that can augment the kindred of moon. He also brought forth sessile, mobile, bipeds, and quadrupeds. And then he devised females, on envisioning the need for the recipient of seed.
verses.bhavadeepa: सूक्ष्मोऽल्पोऽपि धर्मः महोदर्को महाफलः। दुस्तरो विघ्नबाहुल्यात्॥४४॥
